messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High latency anomaly detected in inference-prod during model rollout (upgrade-20260315). p95 jumped from ~110ms -> ~1.1s, p99 ~250ms -> ~2.8s, streaming stall rate up 4x over baseline. Affected route: /v1/stream/generate. Triggered by traffic shift to model-encoder-v12. Paging ryan (oncall) and infra.
ryan (oncall): I’m paged, looking. Saw alert, pulling up traces and kube events. Do we have rollout ID?
helena: rollout id: upgrade-20260315-enc-v12. Canary to 10% started ~04:10 UTC. Metrics started diverging ~04:18.
sana: Confirming streaming sessions reporting repeated stalled frames and reconnects. Customer telemetry: avg session stalls/sec increased ~0.35 -> 1.5.
ryan (oncall): ok. Can we confirm if this is a model performance change (longer decode) or infra (KV/serving runtime blocking)? Helena, any encoder logs?
helena: initial logs show higher per-token latency in the encoder kernel paths. Sample from a worker: ```2026-03-15T04:19:02Z [worker-7] decode_step time=18.4ms (baseline 3.2ms) stack: kernel_launch queue congested``` Also seeing KV cache lock contended messages in runtime logs.
mike: KV lock + kernel delay sounds like batch formation mismatch for v12. It has longer seq lengths, maybe sequencing pushed into hot paths. Can we isolate by routing traffic to cpu-inference variant?
sana: Quick customer impact: two mid-market customers reported streaming timeouts around 04:20-04:30 UTC. No 5xx spike, mostly client-side streaming timeouts and p99 latency spikes. CS loop notified.
ryan (oncall): Action plan: 1) Pause rollout / stop shifting more traffic. 2) Shift existing canary traffic back to stable variant. 3) If needed, rollback rollout. 4) If rollback not immediate, apply traffic gating and scale up dedicated pools. Who can execute traffic shift?
helena: I can gate the rollout and set canary_weight=0 via controlplane. Command (internal): ```POST /api/v1/rollouts/upgrade-20260315-enc-v12/actions -d '{"set_canary_weight":0}'```
ryan (oncall): do that now.
helena: done — canary weight set to 0. New requests should be served by model-encoder-v11. Confirming metrics...
incidents-bot: EVENT: rollout weight change applied by helena at 04:25 UTC.
infra-bot: autoscaling triggers: adding 2 GPU pods to stable pool to absorb shifted traffic.
mike: I'm also kicking off a targeted rollback in case there are session state issues. deploy-bot, please prepare rollback patch.
deploy-bot: Preparing rollback manifest. Suggested command: ```kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/encoder-service --to-revision=stable-v11``` Note: will drain current canary pods gracefully. Want me to run?
ryan (oncall): Run it. Notify if drain causes reconnections.
deploy-bot: Rollback started at 04:27 UTC. Drain initiated.
helena: Watching traces — p95 dropped from 1.1s -> 160ms within 2 minutes after gate, p99 trending down but still elevated at 450ms. Streaming stall rate halved.
sana: CS: customers seeing improvement, some reconnects but overall sessions recovered. We have one customer with persistent resume issues; CS following up.
ryan (oncall): Good. Keep rollback until we validate encoder v12 kernel optimizations are pushed. Need root cause triage: probable interactions between v12 seq-length distributions and runtime batching + KV contention. Mike, can you own kernel+batching investigation? Helena, follow infra logs for KV lock patterns.
mike: On it. I'll reproduce locally with seq-length 2-10x baseline and run the profiler. Early hypothesis: v12 perf regression in new attention kernel triggers longer execution time, causing batch buildup and KV lock escalations.
helena: Also seeing a small uptick in allocation churn on worker-7 that could exacerbate latency. Capturing heap/dma stats.
ryan (oncall): Customer impact summary for handoff: - Window: 04:18-04:27 UTC. - Visible symptoms: p95/p99 spikes, streaming stalls, some session timeouts. - Affected: subset of hosted streaming users and two mid-market customers on the canary path. - Mitigation: Canary gated to 0, rollback to v11, autoscale stable pool + pod drains. - Current status: degraded -> recovering; p95 ~160ms, p99 ~420ms, stalls trending down.
customer-success: Logged customers notified at 04:32 UTC. Working on post-recovery outreach.
ryan (oncall): I'm handing off to night SRE team for monitoring and RCA. Please keep this thread updated with kernel/batching findings and any postmortem notes. Tag me if any regression reappears.
mike: Will post profiler dump + repro matrix here within 2 hours. Early repro: sending mixed seq lengths (prompt len ~1k tokens) reproduces the stall.
helena: Saving logs and KV contention traces to /internal/incidents/2289012345/. Will attach link in follow-up.
sana: CS will collect customer logs for the two affected accounts; will request timestamps and sample session ids.
ryan (oncall): TL;DR: rollout caused runtime contention under v12 traffic profile -> gating + rollback mitigated live impact. Handoff to SRE/infra/machine-performance teams. Postmortem needed, include rollout safety checklist updates (auto-throttle, sequence-length smoke tests, canary weight ramp guardrails). :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Severity reduced to P2 at 04:38 UTC — monitoring. Please file postmortem with tag #upgrade-20260315 by EOD.
